clauses.clause: Route readability: Luna reaches the depot, Annex and garage without > 60 s lost (tune).
clauses.note: Fresh named Luna screenshot-only low-tier trial: depot pickup reached at turn33. Personally inspected all19 action states35–53 at original resolution on five four-cell sheets: bakery/ambulance/depot facade/fence/excavator block repeatedly revisited; no Annex route found. Ticks3009–7249 span70.6667 active seconds, exceeding60. HUD Annex distances123m at35, minimum97m at46,108m at53. Later turns54–57 improve102→73m; retained rather than hidden, but prior >60s lost episode remains. Model receives only fresh attached screenshot plus its recent decisions/actions, no tools/DOM/coordinates/maps; all agent item audits tool-free. Protection/aim assist for navigation, no skips/relocation. Reservation deliberately stopped before10min; resulting fetch error is a harness bound, not game failure. Low counterexample establishes FAIL; no high-tier route PASS claimed.
